parameter.name: maxLineWidth
parameter.label: Maximum Line Width
parameter.description: Maximum line length before text wrapping occurs.

parameter.name: splitLines
parameter.label: Split Long Lines
parameter.description: Split long string scalar lines that exceed the maximum line width.

parameter.name: sectionSpacing
parameter.label: Section and Entity Spacing
parameter.description: Number of blank lines to inject before top-level section keys and individual entities (0 to disable).
